v.changeSummary: found and fixed two pre-existing bugs in apps/durante/src/server.mjs during this deploy's pre-check: (1) @lenticule-science/metrologic was referenced by web/index.html's import map and vendored by the generic /vendor/ route but never declared as a package.json dependency, so it was never installed (added as an exact pin, 0.1.1, matching the version whose exports match the import map); (2) the generic vendor route's VENDOR_SCOPES allowlist omitted '@lenticule-science' even though the route's own comment named it as a served scope, so the file 404'd even once installed (added to the allowlist). Also condensed two loose prose comment blocks (23 and 18 lines) to satisfy the repo's comment-discipline hook, which blocked any edit to the file until they were shortened -- no content lost, JSDoc-shaped where applicable. Local suite went from 138/140 (pre-fix) to 140/140 (post-fix).
